title: Tiny Fishing Villages
short_description: Build a cosy Scottish fishing village, manage a hardworking fleet, and grow a thriving coastal community inspired by real locations across Scotland.
description:
Build a cosy Scottish fishing village, manage a hardworking fleet, and grow a thriving coastal community inspired by real locations across Scotland.

A relaxing village builder made solo as a tribute to Scotland's coastal communities, their heritage and traditions. Start with a handful of buildings and a small fishing fleet, send out boats, gather resources and expand your harbour. Built on the foundations of Tiny Terra Spaces.
